description:
Run holdout confirmation for the selected logical-buffer outcome against the pinned current baseline, or publish the final no-change verdict.

## Background

A production change requires dispatch-inclusive before/after evidence on the exact declared domain plus neighboring non-regression cells. A no-adoption decision still preserves the complete candidate record and explains why the current route remains selected.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Any production change has paired or interleaved holdout samples against the pinned pre-change baseline with adjusted confidence bounds and equivalence-margin results for primary and neighboring cells.
- [hard] REQ-02: Whole-consumer cells demonstrate the predeclared worthwhile benefit without regression outside the selected domain; otherwise the change is not accepted and the contradictory evidence remains committed.
- [hard] REQ-03: The receipt pins contract, addendum, executable, configuration, inputs, runtime provenance, assembly, profiles, and exact commands by content identity.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
title: Confirm the logical-buffer production outcome
